methods.name: BMAD
methods.full: Breakthrough Method for Agile AI-Driven Development
methods.what: A pipeline of AI personas (analyst, PM, architect, dev, QA) each handing a versioned artefact to the next.

methods.name: AI-DLC
methods.what: Adaptive: run only the lifecycle stages a given change actually needs.
methods.where: A principle across all four phases
methods.when: When the depth of a change is unknown up front. The architect judges depth per change.

methods.name: AiDD
methods.what: The day-to-day craft: context files, story files, editor agents, review by risk, cost habits.
methods.when: Every day, by everyone who writes code.
